question:
The relationship between which of the following groups of items is best represented by the given Venn Diagram?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3e699ddde09aa4db1507951ec77c7637aab34537f205d2e86721f3b3a54525c.png]
solution:
According to the given Venn diagram we have:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c3f579f0c080617dde180b5473ba77a4e97662f27286bfac53d1a62d7180725.png] 

As car and bus come under the motor vehicles. But both the car and bus are different vehicles and so they are separated.

Thus, 'Cars, Buses, Motor Vehicles' is the group of items best represented by the given Venn Diagram.

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 1**__'.
